podcast.body: In 1973, at just 14 years old, Marie Osmond became the youngest artist to achieve a number one hit on the Billboard country chart with this song. "In 1973, 14 year old Marie Osman became the youngest artist to score a number one hit on the Billboard country chart with paper roses."
